text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — onboarding call with Acme Health tomorrow 10am PT. Need to lock the trial scope, success criteria, and any security gotchas before the call.
Mira: On it. Are they doing PHI-sensitive workflows?
Alex: Yes, they mentioned PHI for medical summaries. They asked if we can do a VPC + KMS setup for the trial.
Sam: VPC-peering for Private is doable but adds 2 weeks to setup if they want customer-managed networking. For hosted trial we can offer encrypted at-rest + CMEK, but not full VPC.
Jordan: If PHI, we need documented data flow and a signed BAA. Also confirm retention: do they need logs kept or purged immediately?
Alex: I asked them — initial ask is minimal logs, but product team will need a subset retained for quality. They said 90 days max.
Mira: For acceptance criteria, propose: 1) Quality: >=90% pass rate on a 50-prompt eval set (golden labels, blind), 2) Latency: p95 <= 250ms, 3) Cost: avg inference cost < $0.15/request under expected mix. Is that reasonable?
Sam: Latency p95 250ms depends on model size and sequence length. If they use a 2k token average request, we should recommend a 7B quantized variant for the trial. That should hit ~200–250ms p95 with our Dedicated config.
Alex: Good — we'll suggest smaller prompt footprints too.
Jordan: Security checklist: BAA, KMS/CMEK support, network controls (VPC or Private), IAM for service accounts, audit logs (read-only to client), and vulnerability scan report. Anything else?
Mira: Also include eval governance: who approves the golden set, acceptance owner at customer, and rollback criteria if quality regressions appear.
Alex: Timeline I'm proposing: Week0: SOW + BAA signed; Week1: env setup (keys, creds, initial access); Week2: upload prompts + golden set; Week3: baseline runs + quick quality pass; Week4: load/latency tests; Week5: remediation window; Week6: acceptance review & sign-off.
Sam: Need to flag capacity reservations if they plan high concurrency — Dedicated reserved nodes take ~3 business days to allocate once booked.
Mira: For pricing: I'll prepare two options — hosted trial estimate (pay-as-you-go with guardrails) and short-term Dedicated quote with a 6-week commitment. Which margin target do you want me to use?
Alex: Use conservative cost estimate for sales: assume 40% overhead on top of unit cost so finance isn't surprised.
Jordan: On KMS: confirm whether customer holds keys (CMEK) or we manage. Customer-held keys require extra ops but better for compliance.
Alex: I'll confirm with them today. Also need to surface any enterprise blockers: legal approvals, SOC2 artifacts, and their internal procurement lead.
Mira: I'll draft the trial runbook and acceptance checklist tonight. Will include: eval script, prompt format, golden label schema, metrics dashboard links, and a short run command.
Mira: snippet for eval runner: ```python
# run_eval.py (example)
from redwood import Client
cli = Client(api_key='REDACTED')
results = cli.run_eval('acme_golden.json', model='rwft-7b-q')
print(results.summary())
```
Alex: Perfect. Can everyone react :thumbsup: if they agree to the timeline and criteria so I can send to the customer?
Sam: :thumbsup:
Mira: :thumbsup:
Jordan: :thumbsup: We'll need to attach SOC2 and SCA docs to the next email.
SecBot: Reminder: run security checklist template v3.2 and attach vulnerability report.
Alex: Thanks — I'll consolidate and share an email draft before EOD.
Mira: I'll also create a short Confluence checklist and link it in the email.
Alex: Great — meeting prep done.
